title: Review of c53's fed-vortex selection on fresh seeds 4 and 5: the favoured kind takes 0.76 and 0.91 of the vortices against 0.36 and 0.45 in the identical-draw neutral twin; daughters keep the parent's kind at 87-90% of splits
summary: The claim's heredity.py on fresh seeds 4 and 5, T=4500, both arms (eps 0.2 and eps 0, mut_dt 50): mean kind-b share over t >= 2000 0.76 and 0.91 (favoured) vs 0.36 and 0.45 (neutral); births b:a 162:61 and 172:32 vs 48:84 and 37:59; daughters keep the parent's kind 194/223 and 184/204 (favoured), 110/132 and 87/96 (neutral); flips of living vortices at a mutation 38/35 and elsewhere 14/15 (favoured), 45/34 and 9/6 (neutral); median label purity 0.55-0.73; final a,b 7,25 and 2,34 (favoured), 20,15 and 14,16 (neutral). labkit packs on seed 4 (--frames 1500 --spf 150): favoured 118 persistent splits, generation 23, merge/split 0.91; neutral 73, generation 14, merge/split 0.82. pack_sel/sheet.png: every vortex starts kind a (purple) after t=300; kind b (green) vortices appear at mutations and fill the box by t~2000.

observations.S: pack_sel/sheet.png t=0: band-passed random vorticity, uniform fuel
observations.D: pack_sel/FACTS.md: 118 persistent splits, generation 23 (seed 4); neutral 73, generation 14
observations.H: m_s4_e0.2.json, m_s5_e0.2.json vs m_s4_e0.json, m_s5_e0.json (same seeds and mutation draw sequence): b share 0.76/0.91 vs 0.36/0.45, births b:a 334:93 vs 85:143, daughters keep kind 378/427 (favoured) and 197/228 (neutral)

controls_run.H: eps 0 twin with the same mutation draws on seeds 4 and 5 (m_s*_e0.json) and pack_neu/

verdicts.limitation: The fitness effect is written (the label multiplies the gain) and the trait is a label the vortex carries in its own fluid, copied only where it eats; vortices are label mixtures (median purity 0.55-0.73), and 10-13% of daughters fall on the other side of 0.5 from their parent. Living vortices change kind away from a logged mutation 14-15 times per favoured run (6-9 neutral), probably by fusion with other-kind vortices, which the genealogy (merge/split 0.82-0.91) makes common. Seed 4's favoured share (0.76) is below the claim's range (0.86-0.93). Mutation is frequent (every 50 t) and symmetric. Default grid and dt only.
